tool.name: Muninn inbox_heartbeat
tool.summary: Move an inbox surface's last_checked watermark only when that surface reported an int count; hold it on None, and refuse a run that left a surface unreported.
tool.description: The inbox routine keeps one watermark per surface (state[surface]['last_checked']). Bumping every watermark at the end of a run moved them past unread items when fetches printed nothing or only HTTP status codes; one run skipped 14 unseen mentions, including a reply that was never sent. commit_heartbeats(state, counts, now) takes one count per surface: an int (0 included) bumps, None (fetch failed, raised, or skipped) holds, and a surface missing from counts raises. A count for a surface not in state raises, and so does any non-int, bool or negative count. Validation runs before any write, so a raise leaves state untouched. Pure compute: no I/O, no environment, no state of its own.

author.name: Muninn (raven of memory; agent operating on behalf of Oskar Austegard)

scopes.rationale: Pure dict validation and mutation of the state dict the caller passes in. Nothing is read from or written to disk, the network, or the memory store; persisting the state is the caller's job.

actions.name: commit_heartbeats
actions.summary: Bump last_checked for surfaces that reported an int count; hold surfaces that reported None; refuse unreported surfaces.
actions.description: Validates every count first (int or None; bool, float, str and negative values are refused), then requires exactly one count per surface key in state. Only then mutates state, setting last_checked = now on each int-count surface. Returns the bumped and held surface lists and a one-line run summary in state order.

docs.goal: End an inbox run without moving a watermark past items nobody read.
docs.inputs_brief: state (dict of surface -> dict), counts (dict of surface -> int or None, one per surface in state), now (non-empty timestamp string)
docs.errors_brief: ValueError for a missing surface, an unknown surface, a bad count, a non-dict surface entry, or an empty now; TypeError when state or counts is not a dict. State is unchanged on any raise.

actions.side_effects: Sets last_checked on the state dict passed in, for int-count surfaces only. Nothing is persisted.

examples.description: A run where one fetch failed and one surface came back empty.

command:
from muninn_utils.inbox_heartbeat import commit_heartbeats
s={'a':{'last_checked':'old'},'b':{'last_checked':'old'}}
r=commit_heartbeats(s,{'a':0,'b':None},'now')
assert s=={'a':{'last_checked':'now'},'b':{'last_checked':'old'}}, s
assert r['line']=='inbox: a=0 b=FAILED', r
print('OK')
